title: 내 습관과 성격 말하기: -는 편이에요
objective: By the end, you can use -는 편이다 with verbs and adjectives to say what someone or something tends to be or do. You will also know when to use -는 and when to use -(으)ㄴ.
summary: This worksheet teaches -는 편이다, a softer way to talk about your habits, your personality, and how things usually are.

task.title: Use -는 편이다 correctly
task.line: Choose, fill in, or write the -는 편이다 form that fits each sentence.

forms.when: Present habits and actions. Use it with a verb stem, with or without a final consonant (가다 → 가는, 먹다 → 먹는).
forms.means: I/they tend to do ~; I usually ~ (more than most people).
forms.exampleMeaning: I tend to get up early in the morning.

forms.when: Describing a quality. Use -ㄴ after a vowel and -은 after a consonant (조용하다 → 조용한, 작다 → 작은). Watch for irregulars: ㅂ-irregular adjectives change ㅂ to 우 (가깝다 → 가까운, 춥다 → 추운), and adjectives ending in ㄹ drop the ㄹ (길다 → 긴, 멀다 → 먼).
forms.means: It is fairly ~; it is on the ~ side.
forms.exampleMeaning: My neighborhood is fairly quiet at night.

forms.when: Adjectives ending in 있다 or 없다 (맛있다, 재미없다) take -는, not -은.
forms.example: 학교 앞 그 식당은 맛있는 편이에요.
forms.exampleMeaning: That restaurant in front of the school is pretty good.

forms.when: Talking about how one past event went, for verbs only (보다 → 본, 읽다 → 읽은).
forms.means: It went fairly ~; I did fairly ~.
forms.exampleMeaning: I did fairly well on this exam.

watchOut: 바쁘는 편이에요 (X) → 바쁜 편이에요 (O): adjectives take -(으)ㄴ, not -는.
커피를 마시는 편이에요 (X) → 커피를 자주 마시는 편이에요 (O): with action verbs, add a word like 자주, 많이, 잘, or 일찍 to show how much or how often.
멋있은 편이에요 (X) → 멋있는 편이에요 (O): words ending in 있다 or 없다 always take -는.
제 키는 180센티미터인 편이에요 (X) → 제 키는 큰 편이에요 (O): don't use 편이다 for exact facts, only for things that are more or less true.
exercises: Choose the right form: 우리 회사는 집에서 (가깝는 / 가까운) 편이에요.
Fill in the blank with 먹다: 저는 매운 음식을 잘 ____ 편이에요.
Fill in the blank with 많다: 이 카페는 주말에 보통 사람이 ____ 편이에요.
Fill in the blank with 재미있다: 요즘 보는 드라마는 꽤 ____ 편이에요.
Choose the natural sentence: ① 저는 서울에 사는 편이에요. ② 저는 길을 잘 찾는 편이에요.
Answer in Korean with 자주 and -는 편이다 (your answer is yes): 친구들을 자주 만나요?
answers: 네, 친구들을 자주 만나는 편이에요. (또는: 네, 자주 만나는 편이에요.)
